title: XSS prevention via Jinja2 autoescaping
description: All user-supplied data (post titles, bodies, usernames, flash messages) is rendered through Jinja2 templates with autoescaping enabled by default for .html files. This prevents stored and reflected XSS. This is a verified security control (assertions.md §3) that must not regress.
spec:
1. Verify all templates are .html files (Jinja2 autoescapes .html by default).
2. Verify user-supplied data (post.title, post.body, post.username, flash messages) is rendered using {{ }} Jinja2 syntax (autoescaped), not {{ ...|safe }} or {% autoescape false %}.
3. Verify no template disables autoescaping.
4. Verify the index template renders post['title'] and post['body'] via standard Jinja2 output.
